intro: Understanding compact descriptions in a library report and expanding them into clear sentences.

piezas.titulo: Frequently used active and passive participles
texto: The active participle can describe the person who carries out an action: **czytelnicy korzystający z sali** («readers who use the room»). The passive describes something that receives the action: **dane zebrane w czerwcu** («data collected in June»).

The adjectival participle agrees with the noun in gender, number and case. In formal texts it allows information to be condensed; if the sentence becomes hard to follow, rephrase it with **który/która/które**.

frases.estudio: Czytelnicy korzystający z nowej sali mogą pracować do późna.
frases.alumno: Readers who use the new room can work until late.

frases.estudio: W raporcie przedstawiono dane zebrane w czerwcu.
frases.alumno: The report presented data collected in June.

frases.estudio: Pracownicy opisujący nową usługę przekazali uwagi zespołowi.
frases.alumno: The staff who describe the new service passed their comments on to the team.

pregunta.texto: What does *dane zebrane w czerwcu* describe?

opciones.texto: Data that were collected in June.
opciones.explicacion: **Zebrane** is passive: the data receive the action of being collected.

opciones.texto: Data that gather information about other people.
opciones.explicacion: The form does not describe who collects the data.

opciones.texto: Data that will be collected next year.
opciones.explicacion: The text places the collection in June.

frase.texto: Czytelnicy korzystający z nowej sali mogą pracować do późna.

opciones.texto: The readers who use the new room can work until late.
opciones.explicacion: The active participle refers to the readers.

opciones.texto: Readers who were moved work early.
opciones.explicacion: The sentence is about using a new room.

opciones.texto: The room uses the readers until late.

pregunta.texto: Complete the passive participle that agrees with *dane*.

frase.texto: Dane ___ w czerwcu opisano w raporcie.

opciones.explicacion: The plural non-personal form agrees with **dane**.
It is an active participle, not a passive one.

pregunta.texto: Rephrase in Polish this sentence with *które*: «Dane zebrane w maju opisują potrzeby czytelników».

textos: Dane, które zebrano w maju, opisują potrzeby czytelników.

piezas.explicacion: Model: «Dane, które zebrano w maju, opisują potrzeby czytelników». Keep the meaning and a clear reference; the relative clause offers an alternative to the participle.
